choppa-v1-description.Text: A heavy Ork blade hammered together from scavenged metal. It is crude, badly balanced and remarkably effective when swung with sufficient enthusiasm.

choppa-v1-flavor.Text: 'It chops. Dat makes it a choppa.'

choppa-v2-description.Text: Someone has taken the unusual step of sharpening this Choppa. The irregular edge now catches armour, flesh and anything else unfortunate enough to stand nearby.

choppa-v3-description.Text: This scarred weapon has earned a reputation for leaving survivors in considerable discomfort. Orks consider this a sign of quality workmanship.

choppa-v4-description.Text: Layer upon layer of dried blood, crude repairs and replacement teeth record the Choppa's long service. Its owners stopped counting victories when they ran out of fingers.

choppa-v5-description.Text: A brutally oversized edge reinforced with whatever metal its owner could steal. Among Orks, calling a weapon 'dead killy' is both high praise and a warning to keep well clear of it.

choppa-v6-description.Text: Every Ork claims to own the biggest and best Choppa. The bearer of this weapon has settled the argument repeatedly and with considerable finality.

choppa-v6-flavor.Text: 'Da best Choppa belongs to da Ork still standin'.'

choppa-waaagh-description.Text: Charge an enemy and strike with the equipped Choppa. Cost: 1 AP.

choppa-strike-description.Text: Make a single melee attack with the equipped Choppa. Cost: 1 AP.

choppa-greater-waaagh-description.Text: Release a deafening war cry. Enemies in the area must pass a Toughness resistance test or become stunned for 1 round. Cost: 1 AP. Usable once per combat.

choppa-v5-slaughter-description.Text: Strike all enemies around the target area for 150% weapon damage, then enter a slaughter-frenzy for 2 rounds. Cost: 2 AP. Usable once per combat.

choppa-v6-slaughter-description.Text: Strike all enemies around the target area for 150% weapon damage, then enter a slaughter-frenzy for 2 rounds. Cost: 2 AP. Usable once per combat.

choppa-slaughter-buff-description.Text: +20% damage and +10 Weapon Skill, but -20% parry and dodge chance for 2 rounds.

big-choppa-v1-description.Text: A two-handed Ork blade assembled from enough scavenged metal to armour a small vehicle. Its owner chose instead to attach it all to one handle.

big-choppa-v1-flavor.Text: 'If ya need two hands, it'z twice as choppy.'

big-choppa-v2-description.Text: Someone has sharpened this already excessive weapon. The work is uneven, enthusiastic and capable of removing several important things at once.

big-choppa-v2-flavor.Text: 'It got bigger. Dat means it got better.'

big-choppa-v3-description.Text: Repeated impacts have bent the blade into a shape its maker insists was intentional. Orks judge the weapon by the size of the dents it leaves behind.

big-choppa-v4-description.Text: This Big Choppa has accumulated extra plates, teeth and weight with every repair. Subtlety was discarded early in the process to make room for more metal.

big-choppa-v5-description.Text: A dead killy monument to poor judgement, built too large for sensible warriors and therefore exactly large enough for an ambitious Ork.

big-choppa-v6-description.Text: The final answer to the ancient Ork question of how large a Choppa ought to be: larger than its wielder, louder than nearby gunfire and preferably still accelerating.

big-choppa-v6-flavor.Text: 'Dis one ends arguments. An' floors Orks.'

big-choppa-big-swing-description.Text: Sweep a broad arc for 110% weapon damage and push every target back 1 cell. The wielder suffers -10% parry and dodge for 1 round. Cost: 2 AP.

big-choppa-spin-description.Text: Spin wildly, striking all nearby enemies for 100% weapon damage and pushing them back 1 cell. The wielder suffers -20 Weapon Skill and dodge for 1 round. Cost: 2 AP. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

big-choppa-bonk-description.Text: Make one spectacularly ill-advised attack for 300% weapon damage. This attack can critically hit. After the attack, the wielder is knocked prone for 1 round. Cost: 2 AP. Usable once per combat.

big-choppa-big-swing-buff-description.Text: -10% parry and dodge chance for 1 round.

big-choppa-spin-buff-description.Text: -20 Weapon Skill and dodge chance for 1 round.

big-choppa-cleave-description.Text: Swing the Big Choppa through the three tiles directly in front of the wielder. Cost: 2 AP.

power-klaw-v1-description.Text: A roaring mechanical claw built from pistons, scavenged armour plate and the Ork conviction that anything worth grabbing is worth crushing.

power-klaw-v1-flavor.Text: 'Grab it. Squeeze it. If it stops movin', squeeze da next one.'

power-klaw-v2-description.Text: A roaring mechanical claw built from pistons, scavenged armour plate and the Ork conviction that anything worth grabbing is worth crushing.

power-klaw-v2-flavor.Text: 'Da extra piston makes it kustom. Da extra noise makes it better.'

power-klaw-v3-description.Text: A roaring mechanical claw built from pistons, scavenged armour plate and the Ork conviction that anything worth grabbing is worth crushing.

power-klaw-v4-description.Text: A roaring mechanical claw built from pistons, scavenged armour plate and the Ork conviction that anything worth grabbing is worth crushing.

power-klaw-v5-description.Text: A roaring mechanical claw built from pistons, scavenged armour plate and the Ork conviction that anything worth grabbing is worth crushing.

power-klaw-v5-flavor.Text: 'If you ain't fallin' over, you ain't squeezin' hard enough.'

power-klaw-v6-description.Text: A roaring mechanical claw built from pistons, scavenged armour plate and the Ork conviction that anything worth grabbing is worth crushing.

power-klaw-v6-flavor.Text: 'Only da boss gets to press ALL da buttons.'

power-klaw-krump-description.Text: Strike one enemy with the Power Klaw for normal weapon damage. Cost: 1 AP.

power-klaw-sweep-description.Text: Sweep the Power Klaw through the three tiles directly in front of the wielder for normal weapon damage. Cost: 2 AP.

power-klaw-push-description.Text: Strike one enemy for normal weapon damage. On a hit, push the target 1 cell away without provoking attacks of opportunity. Cost: 2 AP.

power-klaw-armour-description.Text: Strike one enemy for normal weapon damage. On a hit, both the target and the wielder lose all armour absorption for 2 rounds against all attackers. Deflection, dodge and parry are unchanged. On a miss, neither loses armour. Cost: 2 AP. Cooldown: 3 rounds from use, including on a miss.

power-klaw-armour-buff-description.Text: Armour absorption is capped at 0 for 2 rounds. Deflection, dodge and parry are unchanged.

power-klaw-squeeze-description.Text: Strike one enemy for 200% weapon damage. After the attack, the wielder is knocked prone for 1 round, even if the attack misses. Cost: 2 AP. Cooldown: 4 rounds from use. Does not automatically knock down the target.

chain-choppa-v1-description.Text: An Ork chainsword whose motor is almost as dangerous as its teeth. Standard strike and cleave remain reliable; its special attacks can kick back, jam or throw the wielder to the ground. Base damage: 8–13. Armour penetration: 20%. Automatically upgrades outside combat at party levels 16, 26, 36, 44 and 50.

chain-choppa-v1-flavor.Text: 'Da teef do da work. Mind yer fingers.'

chain-choppa-v2-description.Text: An Ork chainsword whose motor is almost as dangerous as its teeth. Standard strike and cleave remain reliable; its special attacks can kick back, jam or throw the wielder to the ground. Base damage: 10–16. Armour penetration: 20%. Automatically upgrades outside combat at party levels 16, 26, 36, 44 and 50.

chain-choppa-v2-flavor.Text: 'Mek sez da extra bolts make it safe.'

chain-choppa-v3-description.Text: An Ork chainsword whose motor is almost as dangerous as its teeth. Standard strike and cleave remain reliable; its special attacks can kick back, jam or throw the wielder to the ground. Base damage: 18–27. Armour penetration: 25%. Automatically upgrades outside combat at party levels 16, 26, 36, 44 and 50.

chain-choppa-v4-description.Text: An Ork chainsword whose motor is almost as dangerous as its teeth. Standard strike and cleave remain reliable; its special attacks can kick back, jam or throw the wielder to the ground. Base damage: 22–33. Armour penetration: 25%. Automatically upgrades outside combat at party levels 16, 26, 36, 44 and 50.

chain-choppa-v5-description.Text: An Ork chainsword whose motor is almost as dangerous as its teeth. Standard strike and cleave remain reliable; its special attacks can kick back, jam or throw the wielder to the ground. Base damage: 27–41. Armour penetration: 30%. Automatically upgrades outside combat at party levels 16, 26, 36, 44 and 50.

chain-choppa-v6-description.Text: An Ork chainsword whose motor is almost as dangerous as its teeth. Standard strike and cleave remain reliable; its special attacks can kick back, jam or throw the wielder to the ground. Base damage: 34–50. Armour penetration: 35%. Automatically upgrades outside combat at party levels 16, 26, 36, 44 and 50.

chain-choppa-v6-flavor.Text: 'If ya can still hear it, it ain't loud enough!'

chain-chain-description.Text: Overrev the motor for an attack with 150% weapon damage with normal character modifiers. Before the attack, there is a 20% chance of kickback: instead of attacking the target, deal half your tier's base weapon damage to yourself. Self-damage cannot critically hit, gains no offensive damage bonuses and is reduced by your defences. Cost: 2 AP. Cooldown: 2 rounds from use, including kickback and misses.

chain-bite-description.Text: Make a normal attack. On a hit, attempt up to three additional attacks against the same target, each with 35% weapon damage with normal character modifiers. A miss ends the sequence. After each successful additional hit there is a 25% chance the chain jams: the sequence ends and you cannot parry for 1 round. Cost: 2 AP for the whole sequence. Cooldown: 3 rounds from use, including misses.

chain-red-description.Text: Make a reckless circular attack with 150% weapon damage with normal character modifiers against everyone within 1 cell, including allies but excluding yourself. Then roll once: equal chances of no mishap, a jammed motor for 1 round, or being knocked prone for 1 round. A jammed motor blocks all three Chain Choppa special abilities; normal strike and cleave remain usable. Cost: 3 AP. Cooldown: 4 rounds from use.

chain-jam-description.Text: The motor is jammed for 1 round. CHAAAAAAAAAAIN!, DON'T LET GO! and DA BUTTON WUZ RED! cannot be used. Normal strike and cleave remain available.

chain-no-parry-description.Text: The chain has caught and the follow-up sequence ended. You cannot parry for 1 round.

ork-cache-description.Text: A battered cache of Ork weapons. Four ways to make a proper mess. No refunds.
